basic_profile.bio: I've been collecting vinyl records for over a decade, and Reddit has been my go-to place for sharing this passion. I live in Portland, Oregon, where the indie music scene is vibrant and inspiring. When I'm not flipping through records, I work as a graphic designer for a local studio. I enjoy late-night Reddit browsing, often after my evening vinyl sessions. I'm single and love meeting fellow vinyl enthusiasts online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep knowledge of vinyl records, acquired through years of collecting and participating in record fairs. My graphic design background also influences my appreciation for album cover art. Much of my expertise comes from self-teaching and engaging with the community on forums and subreddits.
